title: Rope: Tie Up, Leave Tied, Cut Free

sections.heading: Tying someone up
items: Anyone carrying a Rope can now tie up another player: press X on them and choose Tie Up. Someone who is down is tied at once. Anyone standing is asked first, and nobody who says no is tied. Each knot uses one rope.
If they say no, or do not answer, you cannot ask them again for 2 minutes.
A player tied with rope is led along like a guard's prisoner. Their captor can Untie them, choose Leave Tied Here to leave them where they stand, and Lead to take them along again.
Guards and officials keep their shackles. Nothing about arrests changes.

sections.heading: Getting free
items: Rope is weaker than shackles. With your captor close, /struggle is as hard as ever. Left alone, with your captor more than 10 metres away for 30 seconds, the knots loosen: struggling is much easier and you can try every minute.
After 5 minutes alone in all, the rope slips off by itself. The time stops while your captor is back beside you, but it does not start over.
Friends can cut you free: stand right next to someone tied with rope, press X and choose Cut Free. It takes 5 seconds and fails if either of you moves. Shackles cannot be cut.
Once free of a rope, nobody can tie you up again for a minute, unless you are down.
